header.title: AI chip-design spend ramps meaningfully in 2027 as next killer app after coding

s01_bottom_line.text: SemiAnalysis believes AI spend on chip design will start ramping meaningfully in 2027, calling it the next killer app after coding, and overweighted the domain in GDPx.
SemiAnalysis frames chip design as a near-term high-ROI AI deployment domain worth tracking via benchmarks and its revenue demand model.
The article names no listed EDA or chip-design-tooling company and quantifies no revenue effect, so the investable link to public equities is unestablished.

items.text: SemiAnalysis believes AI spend on chip design will start ramping meaningfully in 2027, calling it the next killer app after coding.
SemiAnalysis is building a demand model projecting OpenAI and Anthropic revenue in 2027 and 2028, closely tied to the domains selected for GDPx.
Chip design is the only GDPx domain with 3 contributing partners
